scientific_integrity: The originating operator, fixed-point formulas, and earlier two-dimensional basin and invariant-curve work are fully attributed to Shoyimardonov and Rozikov. All universal claims here are supported by an analytical proof; numerical checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only the positive homogeneous quadratic family on the nonnegative cone, every fixed finite dimension; no uniform directional convergence rate or elementary form for the separating radius. General homogeneous radial cocycles are not asserted novel in isolation. Similar independent or unindexed results are possible.
title: An exact global separatrix and water-filling convergence for a positive quadratic map
